name: s127-test-run-placeholder-less-key-is-off

setup_files.src/calc.ts: export const add = (a, b) => a + b;

notes: TAN-7039. A test-file command with no {file} placeholder would run the project's whole suite after every edit, which is the cost the per-edit gate exists to avoid — so the hook treats it as off and runs nothing (ran.txt proves it). The config error itself is the quality gate's to report (s110): one validator, one voice.
